our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is an estimated revenue requirement for recovering AI capital spending and associated costs, not merely a claim that Zitron made an estimate.
I estimate is a qualification of precision, not a conditional antecedent.
The estimate is treated as approximately two dollars of incremental revenue per dollar of AI capital spending. No recovery deadline or margin assumption is supplied.
Use July through September 2025 as the latest pre-post reporting period for testing the asserted current economics. This does not impose a one-quarter repayment deadline.
criteria.support_condition: A transparent calculation using attributable AI capital costs, operating costs, margins, and an identified recovery period substantiates approximately two dollars of incremental revenue per dollar invested for the named hyperscalers.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evidence using the same investment scope and recovery period establishes a materially different revenue requirement, showing that the proposed ratio is insufficient or unnecessary.
